subject: DI04000251

h.gu: 4.1.1 Torque એક Chainમાંથી પસાર થાય છે

body.en:
Start with the situation

A motor shaft may be strong while its key crushes or coupling bolts shear. The full torque path needs design.

Definition / principle

Torsion is twisting under torque; for a circular elastic shaft, T/J=tau/r=Gtheta/L.

Understand why

The shaft, key, hub, sleeve/flange and fastening system must each transmit the required torque.

Application / illustration

Power and speed establish torque; strength and stiffness can give different required diameters.

Common mistake / conditions

Use Nmm with mm sections; 1Nm=1000Nmm. A keyway can reduce shaft strength and introduce concentration.

Does shaft strength guarantee acceptable twist?

No. Strength and stiffness are separate requirements.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Motor shaft strong હોય છતાં key crush કે coupling bolts shear થાય;આખા torque pathનું design જોઈએ.

Definition / Principle

Torqueથી થતું twisting torsion છે;circular elastic shaftમાં T/J=tau/r=Gtheta/L.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Shaft,key,hub,sleeve/flange,fastening system દરેકને required torque transfer કરવો પડે.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Power,speedથી torque મળે;strength,stiffnessથી diameterની જુદી જરૂરિયાત મળે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

mm sectionsમાં Nmm લો;1Nm=1000Nmm.Keyway shaft strength ઘટાડે,concentration બનાવે.

Shaft Strengthથી Twist યોગ્ય હોવાની Guarantee?

ના.Strength,stiffness જુદાં requirements છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

The elementary relation assumes a suitable circular, homogeneous, linear-elastic shaft.

Understand why

Solid:J=pi d⁴/32; maximum shear=16T/(pi d³).

Hollow:J=pi(Do⁴−Di⁴)/32; maximum shear=16TDo/[pi(Do⁴−Di⁴)].

Angle of twisttheta=TL/(GJ) is in radians; convert to degrees only afterward.

PowerP=2pi NT/60 for Nrev/min, TNm, PW; use exact conversion or an explicitly rounded9550PkW/N approximation.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Elementary relation suitable circular,homogeneous,linear-elastic shaft માટે છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Solidમાં J=pi d⁴/32;maximum shear=16T/(pi d³).

Hollowમાં J=pi(Do⁴−Di⁴)/32;maximum shear=16TDo/[pi(Do⁴−Di⁴)].

Twist angle theta=TL/(GJ) radiansમાં છે;પછી degreesમાં ફેરવો.

Nrev/min,TNm,PW માટે P=2pi NT/60;exact conversion કે explicitly rounded9550PkW/N approximation લો.

h.en: 4.1.3 Types of shafts and design procedure

body.en:
Definition / principle

A shaft usually transmits torque; an axle primarily supports rotating parts and may or may not rotate.

Understand why

Transmission shafts include line/counter shafts; machine shafts include spindles, crankshafts and other duty-specific members.

Solid and hollow shafts differ in mass, manufacture, bore function and torsional stiffness; flexible shafts serve special motion paths.

Find torque, transverse forces, bearing reactions and bending moments; consider axial load, shock, keys, shoulders and duty cycles.

Size for strength, twist, deflection and dynamic requirements; choose standard dimensions and recheck.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Shaft સામાન્ય રીતે torque આપે;axle મુખ્યત્વે rotating parts support કરે,પોતે rotate થાય કે નહિ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Transmissionમાં line/counter shaft;machineમાં spindle,crankshaft,duty-specific members.

Solid/hollowમાં mass,manufacture,bore function,stiffness જુદાં;flexible shaft special motion paths માટે.

Torque,transverse force,bearing reactions,bending moments શોધો;axial load,shock,keys,shoulders,duty cycles જુઓ.

Strength,twist,deflection,dynamicsથી size લો;standard dimensions પસંદ કરીને recheck કરો.

body.en:
Given and model

Power15kW, N300rev/min, allowable shear40MPa; steady torque model.

Step-by-step solution

  1. T=60×15000/(2pi×300)=477.4648Nm=477464.8Nmm
  2. dmin=[16×477464.8/(pi×40)]^(1/3)=39.3203mm
  3. Trial d40mm:shear=16×477464.8/(pi×40³)=37.9954MPa

Common mistake / conditions

This40mm trial passes nominal torsional strength, but it must still meet twist and any bending/keyway/fatigue requirements.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Power15kW,N300rev/min,allowable shear40MPa;steady torque model.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. T=60×15000/(2pi×300)=477.4648Nm=477464.8Nmm
  2. dmin=[16×477464.8/(pi×40)]^(1/3)=39.3203mm
  3. Trial d40mm:shear=16×477464.8/(pi×40³)=37.9954MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

40mm trial nominal torsional strengthમાં pass,પણ twist,bending/keyway/fatigue requirements બાકી છે.

body.en:
Given and model

Use preceding torque477464.8Nmm, length1000mm, G80000MPa, twist limit1degree.

Step-by-step solution

  1. At d40:J=pi×40⁴/32=251327.4123mm⁴
  2. theta=477464.8×1000/(80000×251327.4123)=.0237472rad=1.3606degrees
  3. Minimum stiffness diameter=[32TL/(pi G theta limit)]^(1/4)=43.2010mm
  4. Select45mm:theta≈.014825rad≈.8494degrees

Common mistake / conditions

A strength-only40mm answer fails the stated stiffness limit; 45mm is a new trial needing all other checks.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

અગાઉનું torque477464.8Nmm,length1000mm,G80000MPa,twist limit1degree.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. At d40:J=pi×40⁴/32=251327.4123mm⁴
  2. theta=477464.8×1000/(80000×251327.4123)=.0237472rad=1.3606degrees
  3. Minimum stiffness diameter=[32TL/(pi G theta limit)]^(1/4)=43.2010mm
  4. Select45mm:theta≈.014825rad≈.8494degrees

Common Mistake / શરતો

Strength-only40mm answer stated stiffnessમાં fail થાય;45mm નવા trialના બધા checks કરવાના.

body.en:
Given and model

T1000Nm, shear limit50MPa, bore ratio k=Di/Do=.6.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Do min=[16×1000000/(pi×50×(1−.6⁴))]^(1/3)=48.9133mm
  2. Select Do50, Di30mm
  3. Shear=16×1000000×50/[pi(50⁴−30⁴)]=46.8103MPa

Common mistake / conditions

The bore ratio is an input, not a universal optimum; check twist, bending, connections and manufacturing constraints.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

T1000Nm,shear limit50MPa,bore ratio k=Di/Do=.6.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Do min=[16×1000000/(pi×50×(1−.6⁴))]^(1/3)=48.9133mm
  2. Select Do50,Di30mm
  3. Shear=16×1000000×50/[pi(50⁴−30⁴)]=46.8103MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

Bore ratio input છે,universal optimum નહિ;twist,bending,connections,manufacture જુઓ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

The same shaft surface can carry normal bending stress and torsional shear.

Understand why

For a solid shaft:sigma b=32M/(pi d³), tau=16T/(pi d³).

Maximum-shear/Tresca equivalent torqueTe=sqrt(M²+T²), so tau max=16Te/(pi d³) when axial stress is absent.

Maximum-principal-stress equivalent bendingMe=[M+sqrt(M²+T²)]/2 for a stated positiveM magnitude.

Ductile designs often use a yield criterion such as Tresca/vonMises; do not mix equivalent stresses with an unrelated allowable.

Shock/fatigue factors onM, T are empirical model inputs, not a complete fatigue-life analysis.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Same shaft surface પર bending normal stress,torsional shear હોઈ શકે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Solid shaftમાં sigma b=32M/(pi d³),tau=16T/(pi d³).

Axial stress વગર Tresca equivalent torque Te=sqrt(M²+T²);tau max=16Te/(pi d³).

Stated positive M magnitude માટે maximum-principal-stress equivalent bending Me=[M+sqrt(M²+T²)]/2.

Ductile designમાં Tresca/vonMises જેવા criterion;equivalent stressને unrelated allowable સાથે ન ભેળવો.

M,Tના shock/fatigue factors empirical inputs છે,complete fatigue-life analysis નહિ.

body.en:
Given and model

M400Nm, T300Nm, allowable maximum shear40MPa; solid shaft, no axial force.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Te=sqrt(400²+300²)=500Nm
  2. dmin=[16×500000/(pi×40)]^(1/3)=39.9295mm
  3. Select d40:equivalent maximum shear=16×500000/(pi×40³)=39.7887MPa
  4. Me=(400+500)/2=450Nm

Common mistake / conditions

The criterion here is the supplied maximum-shear limit; Me is shown for comparison, not as a second unexplained pass rule.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

M400Nm,T300Nm,allowable maximum shear40MPa;solid shaft,axial force નહિ.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Te=sqrt(400²+300²)=500Nm
  2. dmin=[16×500000/(pi×40)]^(1/3)=39.9295mm
  3. Select d40:equivalent maximum shear=16×500000/(pi×40³)=39.7887MPa
  4. Me=(400+500)/2=450Nm

Common Mistake / શરતો

અહીં supplied maximum-shear limit criterion છે;Me comparison માટે છે,unexplained બીજો pass rule નહિ.

title.en: 4.2 Keys and couplings:check the torque path
title.gu: 4.2 Keys અને Couplings:Torque Path Check કરો

body.en:
Definition / principle

A key prevents relative rotation between suitable shaft and hub by transmitting tangential force.

Understand why

Rectangular/square sunk keys fit matching shaft/hub keyways; feather keys permit axial sliding while transmitting torque.

Woodruff keys use a semicircular form useful in selected small/tapered shaft arrangements.

Saddle keys rely more on friction and suit light duty; gib-head forms aid removal where appropriate.

Splines provide multiple teeth/lands with different load-sharing and fitting rules; do not assume a spline is one oversized sunk key.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Key tangential force transfer કરીને shaft,hubનું relative rotation અટકાવે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Rectangular/square sunk key matching keywaysમાં;feather key torque સાથે axial slidingની મંજૂરી આપે.

Woodruff key semicircular formથી selected small/tapered shaftમાં ઉપયોગી.

Saddle key વધુ friction આધારિત,light dutyમાં;gib-head form appropriate removalમાં મદદ કરે.

Splinesમાં multiple teeth/lands,જુદા load-sharing/fitting rules;એક oversized key ન માનો.

h.en: 4.2.2 Design of a rectangular sunk key

body.en:
Definition / principle

For shaft diameterd and torqueT, the tangential forceF=2T/d.

Understand why

With widthb, height h, engaged lengthl:key shear area=b l.

If half the key height bears in the hub, the elementary projected crushing area=(h/2)l.

Required length from shear l≥2T/(d b tau); from crushing l≥4T/(d h sigma c).

Choose standard cross-section and usable engagement, then check shaft/hub weakening, fit and key-end effects.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Shaft diameter d,torque T માટે tangential force F=2T/d.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Width b,height h,engaged length lમાં key shear area=b l.

અડધી height hubમાં bear થાય તો elementary crushing area=(h/2)l.

Shearથી l≥2T/(d b tau);crushingથી l≥4T/(d h sigma c).

Standard cross-section,usable engagement લો;shaft/hub weakening,fit,key-end effects જુઓ.

body.en:
Given and model

T500Nm, d40mm, b12mm, h8mm; allowable key shear50, crushing100MPa.

Step-by-step solution

  1. F=2×500000/40=25000N
  2. lshear=25000/(12×50)=41.6667mm
  3. lcrush=25000/[(8/2)100]=62.5mm; select l70mm
  4. Actual shear=25000/(12×70)=29.7619MPa
  5. Actual crushing=25000/[(8/2)70]=89.2857MPa

Common mistake / conditions

Use actual effective length, not the entire hub length if rounded ends or relief reduce contact.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

T500Nm,d40mm,b12mm,h8mm;key shear allowable50,crushing100MPa.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. F=2×500000/40=25000N
  2. lshear=25000/(12×50)=41.6667mm
  3. lcrush=25000/[(8/2)100]=62.5mm;select l70mm
  4. Actual shear=25000/(12×70)=29.7619MPa
  5. Actual crushing=25000/[(8/2)70]=89.2857MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

Rounded ends/reliefથી contact ઘટે તો actual effective length લો,આખી hub length નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A coupling connects shafts to transmit torque; type depends on alignment, assembly and duty.

Understand why

Muff/sleeve, split-muff and rigid flange couplings require suitable alignment and rigid connection.

Flexible pin-bush, elastomeric, gear and other couplings accommodate specified limited misalignment—not arbitrary displacement.

Coupling selection includes design torque, starts/shock, speed, bore, keyways, temperature and balance.

Guards are required for exposed rotating couplings; flexibility does not remove alignment or inspection duties.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Coupling shafts જોડીને torque આપે;type alignment,assembly,duty પર આધારિત.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Muff/sleeve,split-muff,rigid flangeમાં suitable alignment,rigid connection જોઈએ.

Flexible pin-bush,elastomeric,gear વગેરે specified limited misalignment લે,arbitrary displacement નહિ.

Selectionમાં design torque,starts/shock,speed,bore,keyways,temperature,balance આવે.

Exposed rotating couplingમાં guard જોઈએ;flexibilityથી alignment,inspection દૂર નથી થતાં.

h.en: 4.2.5 Muff design procedure and load path
h.gu: 4.2.5 Muff Design Procedure અને Load Path

body.en:
Definition / principle

A sleeve bridges coaxial shaft ends; each shaft-to-sleeve engagement carries full torque.

Understand why

Size/check shaft first, then sleeve as a hollow torsion member and each key engagement.

Sleeve shear=16TDo/[pi(Do⁴−Di⁴)] withDi approximately the shaft bore size.

If a sleeve has total length140mm and centred butt, each shaft may engage only70mm before end reliefs.

Two halves transmit torque in series; do not divide torque between them as if they are parallel keys.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Sleeve coaxial shaft ends bridge કરે;દરેક shaft-sleeve engagement full torque લે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

પહેલાં shaft,પછી sleeve hollow torsion member,દરેક key engagement check કરો.

Sleeve shear=16TDo/[pi(Do⁴−Di⁴)];Di લગભગ shaft bore size.

Total sleeve140mm,centred buttમાં end relief પહેલાં દરેક shaftનો engagement70mm હોઈ શકે.

બે halves torque seriesમાં આપે;parallel keys સમજી torque અડધું ન કરો.

body.en:
Given and model

T500Nm, shaft40mm, sleeve Do80/Di40mm, length140mm, key12×8mm with effective70mm EACH side; sleeve shear allowable35MPa.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Sleeve shear=16×500000×80/[pi(80⁴−40⁴)]=5.3052MPa
  2. Shaft nominal shear=16×500000/(pi×40³)=39.7887MPa
  3. Each key:shear29.7619MPa, crushing89.2857MPa from preceding full-torque calculation

Common mistake / conditions

Sleeve passes35MPa; shaft requires at least the stated39.7887MPa allowance plus applicable weakening/fatigue checks. Keys pass the earlier50/100MPa limits.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

T500Nm,shaft40mm,sleeve Do80/Di40mm,length140mm,key12×8mm,દરેક side effective70mm;sleeve shear allowable35MPa.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Sleeve shear=16×500000×80/[pi(80⁴−40⁴)]=5.3052MPa
  2. Shaft nominal shear=16×500000/(pi×40³)=39.7887MPa
  3. Each key:shear29.7619MPa,crushing89.2857MPa from preceding full-torque calculation

Common Mistake / શરતો

Sleeve35MPaમાં pass;shaft માટે ઓછામાં ઓછું stated39.7887MPa allowance સાથે weakening/fatigue checks જોઈએ.Keys અગાઉના50/100MPaમાં pass.

body.en:
Definition / principle

In the elementary fitted-bolt model, bolts carry tangential shear at a pitch-circle radius.

Understand why

Check shaft and each hub key for full torque. Choose hub length/OD from engagement, section strength and standard layout.

For nbolts on pitch diameterDp, force per bolt=2T/(nDp); bolt shear area=pi db²/4.

Check bearing at bolt holes, flange edge ligaments and flange/hub junction shear.

Elementary hub-root flange shear formula tau=2T/(pi Dh² tf) assumes a cylindrical shear surface at hub diameterDh.

Friction-grip/preloaded designs transmit torque differently; do not substitute clearance bolts without revising the model.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Elementary fitted-bolt modelમાં bolts pitch-circle radius પર tangential shear લે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Shaft,દરેક hub key full torque માટે check કરો.Engagement,section strength,standard layoutથી hub length/OD લો.

Dp pitch diameter પર n boltsમાં force/bolt=2T/(nDp);shear area pi db²/4.

Bolt-hole bearing,flange edge ligaments,flange/hub junction shear જુઓ.

Hub diameter Dh પર cylindrical shear surface માની tau=2T/(pi Dh² tf).

Friction-grip/preloaded designનો torque path જુદો;model બદલ્યા વગર clearance bolts substitute ન કરો.

body.en:
Given and model

T500Nm, d40, Dh80, hub length70, flange thickness12, Dp120,4fitted bolts10mm; bolt shear30, bearing60, flange shear15MPa.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Force per bolt=2×500000/(4×120)=2083.3333N
  2. Minimum bolt diameter=sqrt[8×500000/(pi×4×30×120)]=9.4032mm
  3. At db10:bolt shear=2083.3333/(pi×10²/4)=26.5258MPa
  4. Bolt bearing on12mm flange=2083.3333/(10×12)=17.3611MPa
  5. Flange root shear=2×500000/(pi×80²×12)=4.1447MPa

Common mistake / conditions

These checks pass; use each hub key12×8×70mm from the key example and check hub torsion, edge geometry, fit and applicable fatigue/standard requirements.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

T500Nm,d40,Dh80,hub length70,flange thickness12,Dp120,4fitted bolts10mm;bolt shear30,bearing60,flange shear15MPa.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Force per bolt=2×500000/(4×120)=2083.3333N
  2. Minimum bolt diameter=sqrt[8×500000/(pi×4×30×120)]=9.4032mm
  3. At db10:bolt shear=2083.3333/(pi×10²/4)=26.5258MPa
  4. Bolt bearing on12mm flange=2083.3333/(10×12)=17.3611MPa
  5. Flange root shear=2×500000/(pi×80²×12)=4.1447MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ checks pass;દરેક hubમાં key12×8×70mm લો,hub torsion,edge geometry,fit,fatigue/standard requirements જુઓ.

title.en: 4.3 Helical springs:axial load twists the wire
title.gu: 4.3 Helical Springs:Axial Loadથી Wire Twist થાય

body.en:
Definition / principle

A helical spring is coiled wire whose stress mechanism depends on how it is loaded.

Understand why

Compression springs resist shortening; extension springs resist stretching and often include initial tension and hooks.

Torsion springs resist end rotation; their wire primarily bends, unlike the axial compression-spring wire.

Define wired, mean coilD, indexC=D/d, active coilsna, total coilsNt, pitch, free length, solid length and spring ratek=W/delta.

Closed/ground end conditions change active/total coils; solid height≈Nt d for the stated end arrangement.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Helical spring coiled wire છે;stress mechanism loading પ્રમાણે બદલાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Compression shortening સામે;extension stretching સામે અને ઘણીવાર initial tension,hooks સાથે.

Torsion spring end rotation સામે;wire મુખ્યત્વે bend થાય,axial compression springથી જુદું.

Wire d,mean coil D,index C=D/d,active coils na,total Nt,pitch,free length,solid length,rate k=W/delta વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરો.

Closed/ground endsથી active/total coils બદલાય;stated end arrangementમાં solid height≈Nt d.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Use a stated Wahl-corrected shear model for an axially loaded close-coiled spring.

Understand why

Kw=(4C−1)/(4C−4)+0.615/C corrects curvature/direct shear in the common model.

Maximum shear=Kw8WD/(pi d³); deflection=8WD³na/(Gd⁴).

Select wire/coil sizes for stress and rate; check solid clash, clearance, buckling, surge, temperature, fatigue and end details as applicable.

Do not multiply by a second direct-shear correction if the chosen correction factor already includes it.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Axially loaded close-coiled spring માટે stated Wahl-corrected shear model લો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Common modelમાં Kw=(4C−1)/(4C−4)+0.615/C curvature/direct shear correct કરે.

Maximum shear=Kw8WD/(pi d³);deflection=8WD³na/(Gd⁴).

Stress,rateથી wire/coil size લો;solid clash,clearance,buckling,surge,temperature,fatigue,ends જુઓ.

Chosen factorમાં direct shear included હોય તો ફરી second correctionથી multiply ન કરો.

body.en:
Given and model

W500N, C6, d6mm, D36mm, na8, G80000MPa, allowable shear300MPa.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Kw=(24−1)/(24−4)+.615/6=1.2525
  2. Shear=1.2525×8×500×36/(pi×6³)=265.7888MPa
  3. Deflection=8×500×36³×8/(80000×6⁴)=14.4mm
  4. Rate=500/14.4=34.7222N/mm
  5. For closed-ground example Nt=na+2=10; solid height≈10×6=60mm
  6. With clash reserve .15×14.4=2.16mm:minimum free length≈60+14.4+2.16=76.56mm; trial80mm

Common mistake / conditions

The nominal stress and stated length arithmetic pass; 80mm free length still needs buckling, surge, manufacture and fatigue review.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

W500N,C6,d6mm,D36mm,na8,G80000MPa,allowable shear300MPa.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Kw=(24−1)/(24−4)+.615/6=1.2525
  2. Shear=1.2525×8×500×36/(pi×6³)=265.7888MPa
  3. Deflection=8×500×36³×8/(80000×6⁴)=14.4mm
  4. Rate=500/14.4=34.7222N/mm
  5. For closed-ground example Nt=na+2=10;solid height≈10×6=60mm
  6. With clash reserve .15×14.4=2.16mm:minimum free length≈60+14.4+2.16=76.56mm;trial80mm

Common Mistake / શરતો

Nominal stress,length arithmetic pass;80mm free length માટે buckling,surge,manufacture,fatigue review હજી જોઈએ.

h.en: 4.3.4 Extension/torsion springs:do not reuse the wrong formula
h.gu: 4.3.4 Extension/Torsion Springમાં ખોટું Formula ન લો

body.en:
Definition / principle

Spring shape alone does not identify the stress law.

Understand why

Extension-spring deflection beyond initial tension uses(delta load)/rate; hooks can govern by bending and concentration.

Torsion-spring wire sees bending from the applied end moment; curvature and active-leg effects require the suitable torsion-spring model.

Use wind direction, available space, working angles and end restraints from actual service requirements.

Catalogue selection can be preferable where fatigue and end details are critical; nominal stiffness alone is not sufficient.

Torsion spring wire is mainly in torsion?

No. It mainly bends under the applied end torque; the name describes external action.

Do two coupling hubs each carry half torque?

No. They carry full torque sequentially in the load path.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

ફક્ત shapeથી stress law નક્કી નથી થતો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Extensionમાં initial tension પછી deflection=(delta load)/rate;hooks bending,concentrationથી governing બને.

Torsion spring wireમાં end momentથી bending;curvature,active-leg effects માટે suitable model જોઈએ.

Actual serviceથી wind direction,space,working angles,end restraints લો.

Fatigue,end details critical હોય તો catalogue selection સારું હોઈ શકે;nominal stiffness એકલું પૂરતું નહિ.

Torsion Springની Wire મુખ્યત્વે Torsionમાં છે?

ના.End torqueથી મુખ્યત્વે bend થાય;નામ external action બતાવે.

બે Coupling Hubs દરેક Half Torque લે?

ના.Load pathમાં અનુક્રમે full torque લે.
